description: Permissions for every Rocinante window. The UI only reaches the core through the relay commands; it cannot spawn processes or touch the file system. It may show the system dialog to pick a project file or a folder: the writer chooses, and the path goes to the core. A window may destroy itself, so closing it can first wait for the last text to be saved. It may go full screen for focus mode. Through the host's ambience:// protocol it may read the copies of the writer's own images and sounds in the app data folder's ambience/, and nothing else.
